module.title: State Machines and Cross-Domain Workflows
module.business_purpose: Makes lifecycle rules executable and auditable. State codes remain governed terminology concepts, while this module defines initial/terminal states, allowed transitions, actor permissions, guards, idempotency, side effects and immutable transition evidence for critical aggregates.
